verdict.rationale: Buzz has its own in-chat workflow engine: agents and users can run workflows, trigger and approve them from the CLI, and search workflow runs alongside the conversation. However, it is described as "YAML-as-code automation" rather than a no-code builder, and nothing documents event, schedule, or form-submission triggers. Missing for 10: a no-code/visual workflow builder, documented event-based triggers, scheduled (recurring) triggers, form-submission triggers, admin-facing workflow docs, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can build no-code workflows triggered by events, schedules, or form submissions inside the chat tool

citations.quote: buzz workflows trigger --workflow buzz workflows approve --token
Search the conversation, the patch, the workflow run, and the approval in one place
